title: You are moving at 1,600 km/h and feel nothing
body: At the equator, Earth's rotation carries you eastward at about 1,670 kilometres per hour, yet acceleration, not speed, is what bodies sense, and the centripetal change is a gentle third of a percent of gravity. Galileo used the same logic for ships below deck. Uniform motion is undetectable from inside, the seed of relativity itself.
